# Synthetic S-57 cells

Generated by [`tools/make_synthetic_cells.py`](../../tools/make_synthetic_cells.py) with GDAL's
S-57 writer; re-running it must reproduce these files byte for byte. Read them with GDAL like
any NOAA cell (`ogrinfo -ro US4ZZ01M.000`).

**Pins:** chart priority masking and zoom eligibility (audit TE-1, TE-2; fixtures P-TE-5,
P-API-3). Two cells whose coverage overlaps at different compilation scales: inside the overlap
only the larger-scale cell's features may appear on a tile, outside it the smaller-scale cell's
features still appear, and at zooms below the inner cell's zoom only the outer cell is eligible.
`ZZ` is not a US state code, so the names cannot collide with real NOAA cells, and both sit in
open water off Washington, well away from `US5WA22M`.

| Cell | Band | `DSPM_CSCL` | Zoom at 47°N | Coverage (W, S, E, N) | Features |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `US4ZZ01M.000` | approach | 1:80 000 | 11 | -123.20, 46.90, -122.80, 47.10 | `M_COVR`, `DEPARE` 10–20 m, `DEPCNT` 10 m crossing the overlap, `BOYLAT` at (-123.000, 47.000) **in the overlap**, `BOYLAT` west and `LIGHTS` east **outside** it |
| `US5ZZ02M.000` | harbour | 1:10 000 | 14 | -123.05, 46.97, -122.95, 47.03 | `M_COVR`, `DEPARE` 0–5 m, `DEPCNT` 2 m, `BOYSPP` at (-122.990, 47.005) **in the overlap**, `SOUNDG` with four depths incl. a drying height (-0.6) |

Both cells: edition 1, update 0, `DSID_UADT` = `DSID_ISDT` = 20260101, agency 550 (NOAA),
lexical level 1, WGS 84, `COMF` 10 000 000, `SOMF` 10. The inner coverage lies strictly inside
the outer one, and the inner `DEPARE` band is shallower than the outer so the masked overlap is
visibly different on a rendered tile.

`libgdal/src/nativeTest/kotlin/FixtureCellsTest.kt` asserts all of the above through
`OgrS57Dataset`, the same reader the ingest uses.
